sources.title: Introducing LFM2.5: The Next Generation of On-Device AI
sources.snippet: Today, we're excited to announce the LFM2.5-1.2B model family, our most capable release yet for edge AI deployment. It builds on the LFM2 device-optimized architecture and represents a significant leap forward in building reliable agents on the edge.
